control_found.code: Set rs2 = conn.Execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = " & sid & " AND user_id = " & CLng(Session("UserID")))

verifications.notes: The query includes an ownership check by binding the user_id to the session value and casts the sid to a long, preventing injection and ensuring the user can only access their own orders.
